agent_owned_tape_code_flag_roster_seed_a.principle: only live-agent-owned evidence defines the experiment.

development_support_and_selection_contra.principle: development support and held attribution are disjoint.

duplicate_level_and_unreachable_solver_c.principle: duplicate-level and unreachable-solver credit counts must be zero.

duration_s.principle: measured wall-clock for the no-LLM audit.

field_provenance.principle: every required field records its source and rationale.

held_out_leave_one_game_out_arm_counts.principle: held cells are counted only for a frozen selected primitive with matched arms.

honest_verdict.principle: uses complete_positive:, complete_null:, underpowered:, retired:, or blocked:.

live_agent_self_discovery.principle: incidental outcomes arise only from the agent's own runtime attempts.

missing_verifier_gaps.principle: missing live returned-decision receipts or causal arms are explicit gaps.

navigation_replay_budget_bound_crash_and.principle: navigation/replay costs, budget bounds, crashes, and missing observations are explicit.

offline_reproduced_new_level.principle: false unless a live self-discovered path independently passes reproduction.

paired_action_state_progress_and_level_d.principle: accuracy and efficiency are measured together at matched game/seed cells.

per_game_actions_states_progress_levels_.principle: per-game action, state, progress, guarded level, wall time, and failure rows.

per_primitive_live_reachability_firing_a.principle: a primitive must be reachable, fire, return decisions, and affect a live consumer before causal testing.

preconditions_checked.principle: hashes registry, code, flags, tapes, roster, seeds, budgets, result path, protected files, root clutter, and submitted defaults.

primitive_inventory_game_id_free_audit.principle: generic primitives must not require game id, source, adapter, or recipe inputs at runtime.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: scripts/research_conductor.py and other protected files are not modified.

registry_precheck_and_postcheck.principle: pre/post public-registry check over all 25 games; this task proposes zero game-level solves.

selected_primitive_or_none.principle: at most one primitive; none is honest when support is insufficient.

solve_provenance.principle: live_agent_self_discovery is required for any incidental outcome.

status.principle: terminal audit status; complete_null is valid when no supported live solver-kit primitive qualifies.

submitted_defaults_unchanged.principle: no production flag changes follow from this bounded audit.

target_level_solve_claim_count.principle: must be 0; the task improves measurement of a live path and claims no new level.

test_commands.principle: commands used to verify the artifact are recorded.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: false; environment transitions and reproduction are authority, a primitive is not an oracle.

missing_verifier_gaps.effect: object_centric_digest is live-reachable and downstream-consumed, but cannot support held-out causal A/B attribution without per-call decision receipts or a solver-kit ablation arm.

navigation_replay_budget_bound_crash_and.navigation_replay_cost_gap: primary_tape_records actions/states but not replay-vs-probe decomposition
